mechanics.name: Clairvoyance
mechanics.currentEffect: After cleansing or blessing a Totem, while empty-handed hold the Use Item button to reveal Auras of Chests, Exit Gate switches, Generators, the Hatch, and Hooks within 64 metres, for up to 10/11/12 seconds while the interaction is held.
activation: Be empty-handed and hold Use Item.
Ends/deactivates when: Aura reading ends when the button is released or after 10/11/12 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.2.0): Increased maximum aura-reading duration to 10/11/12 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: After interacting with a Totem, you can reveal several important object Auras while empty-handed.
duration: Aura-reading duration: up to 10/11/12 seconds by tier.
specialInteractions: Reveals Chests, Exit Gate switches, Generators, Hatch and Hooks within 64 metres.

editorial.summary: After cleansing or blessing a Totem, while empty-handed you can reveal chests, gates, generators, Hatch, and hooks within 64 metres for up to 12 seconds.
useCases: Locate the Hatch or Exit Gate switches in late-game situations.
Scout hooks, generators, and chests after a Totem interaction.
Use the information burst to plan a long rotation without carrying an Item.
counters: Requires a prior Totem cleanse or blessing.
You must be empty-handed to use it.
The total Aura-reading time is limited.
analysis: Clairvoyance ranks this position because its object list is broad enough to solve several navigation problems at once. The Hatch inclusion is especially notable, giving the perk a potential endgame purpose beyond ordinary generator routing.

The Totem setup is not terrible in builds already cleansing or blessing, but it is still a requirement. The empty-hand condition can also conflict with strong Items, making the perk less attractive in equipment-heavy builds.

The twelve seconds of total use should be treated as a scouting resource rather than a permanent map overlay. A short scan can identify the direction of gates, generators, hooks, or the Hatch before you resume normal movement.
It remains lower B because the information is about objects rather than threats. Useful navigation is nice, but the strongest perks tell you where the Killer is or directly change survival odds.
editorial.verdict: A flexible object scanner with useful Hatch information. Clairvoyance solves navigation problems, but its setup and empty-hand requirement keep it niche.
